title: Enterprise Multimodal Document AI & Complex PDF/Table Parsing Selection Guide: Azure AI Document Intelligence vs. MinerU / IBM Docling vs. Qwen2.5-VL / olmOCR

workload_basis.document_mix: 82% Standard Multi-Column Text/Tables + 18% Complex Merged-Cell Financial Tables, Scans & Charts

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Legacy Rule-Based Extraction (PyMuPDF / pdfplumber Without Layout Vision)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Fails on multi-column PDFs and merged-cell tables (garbage-in, garbage-out RAG)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: 100% Full-Page High-Res Image VLM Parsing (Qwen2.5-VL-72B / GPT-4o Vision)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Wastes 80% of visual tokens on plain text and whitespace margins

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Turnkey Azure AI Document Intelligence (Layout / Prebuilt Markdown API)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Best fit for <=300K pages/month or regulated invoice/contract workflows with zero GPU ops

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (High-Scale Recommended): Hybrid 82% MinerU/Docling Layout Fast-Path + 18% Cropped Qwen2.5-VL-7B HTML Table Path
tiers.recommended_scenario: High-scale enterprise Document AI standard achieving 95.4% table RAG accuracy and -94.9% TCO vs. Tier 2
